Medical College,
Purnia
(Establishment and

Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹522.25 lakh
was the net effect of
increase of ₹622.25 lakh
and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹100.00 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need of
additional amounts in
office expenses,
telephone, travelling
expenses, rented van and
commercial, art &
technical services.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
